title: Heat signature
description: Heat moves through a soft-edged cross in violet, vermilion, and hot white.
useCase: A compact thermal identity, focus indicator, or generative art accent.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Decorative heat map, not a thermal camera or numerical heat-diffusion solver.
look: Rounded plus-shaped mark tilted on a near-black violet field, glowing from deep violet through vermilion to a white-hot yellow core.
motion: A heat hotspot inside the rounded cross drifts up and down on a ~21 s sine while faint bands shift; the range slider moves it sideways.
adapt: The effect is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `shape` is the cross's distance field, `center` the hotspot path, `hot` its falloff and `material` the violet-to-white ramp. Swap `shape` for your mark; keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
